thread.document:
Website: https://182-red-e.vercel.app/

Github: https://github.com/xyntechx/182-red-e 

By: Leon Kornfeld, Nyx Iskandar, Imra Dawoodani

Implementation:

We used GPT to generate code to use the edapi to iterate over all the ed posts and pull them into a JSON.

Cursor analyzed all the post titles to come up with categories, model names, and keywords that it found.

Tagging Round 1: Used Cursor (GPT) to fully vibe code a script that manually searched for common model names and common keywords across all the posts in the JSON and assigned each post tags.

Tagging Round 2: Fed JSON through Cursor’s GPT interface to semantically analyze and correct any mistakes with tagging in round 1.

Used Claude to vibe code a frontend.

Feature Summary:

Working Features:

 • Browsing interface with card layout

 • Multi-criteria filtering (title, author, tags)

 • Tag-based categorization system

 • Clean UI.

Bug Summary

1. Images Render Out of Order

Expected Behavior: Images within a post should display in their correct sequential order as defined in the source data to preserve flow.

2. PDF Renders Too Small

Expected Behavior: The embedded PDF should be clearly readable at a reasonable default size.

Actual Behavior: The PDF embedding displays at a very small size, making the content difficult to read.

Likely Cause: Missing/wrong width and height styling on the PDF embed container, default embed dimensions being too restrictive.

Another example is in Imra Dawoodani’s posts, where the PDF rendering is too small, and all PDFs are embedded at the end of the post, making it unclear when the post says “here are my findings:” and some other text and links follow, rather than the main PDF originally attached 

There.

3. Tags are poorly formatted.

4. Some posts have extraneous tags.

5. Links don’t render well.

Likely Cause: Website is completely vibe coded
